lead.zh: 给想读懂论文和技术报告的人：从模型怎么训练、怎么变小变快，到怎么判断一个评测结果可不可信。
lead.en: For people who want to read papers and tech reports: how models are trained, how they get smaller and faster, and when an eval result is trustworthy.

zh: 把一份技术报告的训练章节拆成预训练/后训练两段，各说出关键变量
看到「刷新 SOTA」的说法，先查评测集发布时间和训练截止日期的关系
读模型卡时能指出许可证、评测口径和已知局限三处关键信息
en: Split a tech report's training section into pretraining and post-training, naming the key variables of each
On seeing a "new SOTA" claim, first check the benchmark's release date against the model's training cutoff
When reading a model card, point out the license, the eval setup, and the stated limitations
